answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47712 Country: India Title: about roza which are missed in ramazan due to haiz Question: (1) I just wanted to ask that what are the steps to fill the sawm which have been missed in Ramadan due to haiz (menses). (2) Is there any sawm in the month of Shaban by which our all sawm get fill which have been missed earlier in Ramadan due to haiz. Answer ID: 47712 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1525/1125/H=11/1434) (1) Your missed fasts shall be complete when you will keep fast with the intention of qaza in the days other than Ramadan and the days in which fast is forbidden. (2) No such alternative is specified in Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
